name: Fused-detector reset: a stronger change detector decides when our field resets a Gaussian (NeRF-Object-Removal)
status: DRAFT 2026-10-23, written before any real-data run of this attempt: only CPU toy tests (tests/test_reset_fused.py) have run. scripts/reset_fused.sh refuses every stage while this file is untracked or has uncommitted changes, and refuses STAGE=test before a finished validation selection (scripts/reset_fused_select.py check-test).
registered: 2026-10-23, before any real-data run; decisions R1-R6 as drafted, accepted by the lead
after: A later attempt, after Table III (tab:change) and the pre-registered fused table (configs/nor_fused_prereg.json) were final. Known before this file: on the NOR test scenes our change test alone has Gaussian AP 53.4, ours+depth 75.0, feature residual+depth 81.1, NormLift drop+depth 79.9 (rank fusion over the update population); our reset lowers the N2 stale-answer rate from 34% (change test off / averaging) to 21% (test mean, N = 10), with Rec 56.8% at FA 6.2%. The test scenes were seen by Table III, the Table IV ablations, the fused baselines and the N2 dumps; this is a further look.

code.scene: scripts/reset_fused_nor.py (imports scripts/eval_change_nor.py and scripts/dump_nor_qual.py, never edits them)
code.frozen: eval_change_nor.py, time_field.py, eval_seg.py, run_mapping.py, every MAPPING_CODE file (incl. usplat/vmf_field.py), usplat/change_baselines.py, dump_nor_qual.py, plot_nor_qual.py, make_tables.py: unchanged; their hashes must equal the Table III records' (eval_code, mapping_code_now)

inputs: the Table III records (uags_results/nor/tab2_relmax/{val,test}/<scene>.json) and the fields, maps and alignments they name (sha256 checked); no re-mapping. Every setting (update stride, tau_cov, undef_frac, k, change quantile, D2 margins) comes from the record.

components.ours: the field's own persistent change score c_p (min of the last k = 2 defined c) at the view, where its test is defined (the variant field's own score, after the variant's own resets)
components.feat: min of the last k = 2 covered per-view feature residuals against the frozen map (Table III 'feat' statistic)
components.depth: the same for the rendered-depth residual (Table III 'depth' statistic)
components.normlift: R_ref - R_t, the drop of NormLift's reliability (mapping: since the reference of NormLift's null segment; update: since the end of mapping), on a field copy with the change test off and the saved NormLift on its hooks (Table III 'normlift' statistic)

fusion: rank_X(x) = mid-rank empirical CDF of x among component X's finite per-view values on the mapping replay (pooled over views and Gaussians; NormLift: its null segment); NaN -> 0. s_V = equal-weight mean of rank_X over V's components; defined on a covered Gaussian where at least one component is finite. Nothing is fitted. (Table III's fused rows rank against the update population and have no per-view scale; this is the per-view form of the same equal-weight rank average.)

threshold.rule: thr_V = the 0.999 empirical quantile (numpy linear, as eval_change_nor.Null.threshold, in float64) of s_V over the mapping replay's covered Gaussian-views (pooled); V3 over the NormLift null segment's views. The same label-free rule as every Table III row (per-view rate 1 - q on static content).

firing: at each update keyframe, after the field took the view: fire on the covered Gaussians with s_V > thr_V that are not currently 'changed' (a Gaussian the variant reset is not reset again before the depth re-admission clears it); the field's own test is off (thresholds +inf); the reset is the field's own (ExternalResetField.external_reset = the state _ingest gives when its test fires on the same set, checked bit for bit on the CPU)
kept_unchanged: the reset itself (evidence restarted from the current view)
the robust set (tau_min, r_stable, not changed)
coverage (EC.covered; each variant pass's observed set must equal ours' up to 1e-4 of the observed Gaussians, since GPU backward sums are not bit-exact; exactly on the CPU)

metrics.stale_answer: N2 (dump_nor_qual.contrast_and_fa): share of the covered masks_real pixels over every update keyframe whose top class (101 classes of configs/vocab_replica.json, LSeg templates, ties = no class) is the scene's N2 query; the query rule of dump_nor_qual (never re-prompted). Lower is better.
metrics.static_relabel: share of the static observed Gaussians (D2) whose top class of mu* after the update differs from the mapping-pass mu*'s. Lower is better (cost).
metrics.firing_score: per Gaussian, the max over the update views of the firing statistic (ours: Table III's c_max; V: s_V); Gaussian AP / AUROC on the observed Gaussians (NaN last) and pixel AP / AUROC (EC.pixel_level)
metrics.fa_rec: flagged = reset at least once in the update; FA on the static observed Gaussians, Rec on the stale observed ones (EC.operating_points), realised per-view rate fires / tests
metrics.kept: share of the stale observed Gaussians in the robust set at the end of the update

reproduction: each scene first reproduces its Table III record with dump_nor_qual.reproduction (keyframes, per-frame counts, AP/AUROC within the noise tolerance 0.002, ours' FA/Rec within 0.5 points) and ours' N2 stale-answer, change-test-off, averaging and before rates within 0.5 points of the scene's dump (uags_results/qual/nor/<scene>/contrast.json); a failure stops the run (exit 2)

selection.rule: On the 4 validation scenes: among [ours, V1, V2, V3] (this order), the row with the lowest mean stale-answer rate (unweighted mean over scenes) among those whose mean static-relabel cost is not above ours' validation mean + static_relabel_budget; ours always qualifies; an exact tie goes to the row listed first. If ours has the lowest rate among the qualifying rows, ours is kept and no variant is selected.

claim.rule: The paper may claim that the fused detector lowers the stale-answer rate only if the selected variant (not ours) has a lower test stale-answer rate than ours in at least 7 of the 10 test scenes (strictly lower; a tie is not a win) AND a lower test mean. The sentence always carries x/10, both means, and the test FA and static-relabel cost of both rows. Otherwise the paper states the measured comparison (or nothing beyond the appendix).

report_all: every variant and ours on validation and test, per scene and as mean +- std (stale-answer, static relabel, FA, Rec, Kept, firing-score G AP / P AP, realised rate, resets), selected or not; test rows of variants not selected are labelled 'not selected'
test_once: STAGE=test runs only after check-test passes (prereg and code committed unchanged, selection finished with this prereg and reproducible); a finished test scene record is never overwritten; a crashed scene may be rerun
disclosure: Paper sentence (with the Table III paragraph or the appendix): 'After Table III was final we tried letting a stronger detector decide the reset (three fused detectors fixed in advance); the variant was chosen on the 4 validation scenes by stale-answer rate under a static-relabel budget, and the test scenes were scored once (a further look at the NOR test split); every variant is in the appendix.'

gpu.basis: per scene the Table III passes (peak 4.56 GiB at N = 1e6 in the records) plus three variant passes run one at a time, each holding one field copy (~1 GiB at N = 1e6, d = 64), ChangeBaselines and for V3 the NormLift copy (~1.3 GiB): the variant passes stay below the run_update peak (two field copies + NormLift); the mapping nulls and ranks live on the CPU
gpu.time: about 1.3-1.6x the N2 dump's wall time per scene (the dumps: 71-968 s, 3645 s for the 14 scenes): ~25-40 min for validation, ~25-35 min for test, under the gate

decisions_open: R1 rank scale: mapping-pass ECDF per component, pooled over history (fixed above). Alternative: per history bucket.
R2 no re-fire while changed (fixed above). Alternative: fire whenever s_V passes (the frozen-map residuals would reset a removed object at every view).
R3 ours is in the selection set and wins ties (fixed above).
R4 static-relabel budget +2 points on the validation mean (from the task).
